subject: CAIQ control synchronization and escrow clarity for upcoming CSA submission
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Elliot Systems <audit@elliotsys.com>
Cc: Natalie Park <natalie.park@quantumpay.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ control synchronization and escrow clarity for upcoming CSA submission

Team / Elliot,

We're finalizing the CAIQ (CSA) answers for QuantumPay's intake and I want to align on two things before we hand over: (1) authoritative control ownership and (2) the evidence escrow expectation (what we upload vs what we certify). Elliot asked for a consolidated mapping that ties each CAIQ question to our control artifact(s) and the actual storage location + retention window.

Proposal:
- Today: review attached draft (csa_answer_draft_v1.pdf) and mapping (control-sync-mapping.xlsx) for obvious gaps.
- Thu 11/04 10:00-10:30 PT: 30m walkthrough with engineering and ops to show where runtime logs & tenant telemetry live.
- Fri 11/05 EOD: owner confirmations and a one-line attestation for items we will place in the escrow bundle.

Specific asks from internal owners:
- Marissa: confirm custodian list in tab "Owners" (sheet 2) and mark any controls that require redaction prior to escrow.
- PrIyom: annotate technical evidence rows where a runtime trace or telemetry extract is the primary proof (we need exact file names/paths).
- Jonas: any controls that reference KMS/HSM or key rotation — please confirm whether we can include rotation logs in the escrow or if we should provide attestations only.

Elliot / Natalie: if you have a preferred ingestion format for the escrow bundle (single ZIP vs per-control links) let us know. We plan to use DocuSign for the sign-off when owners attest.

Attachments: csa_answer_draft_v1.pdf, control-sync-mapping.xlsx, walkthrough-agenda.docx

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Elliot Systems <audit@elliotsys.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control synchronization and escrow clarity for upcoming CSA submission

Thanks Mina — reviewed the mapping and left inline comments in control-sync-mapping.xlsx (sheet "Owners"). Quick notes:
- Owner roster: confirmed for ~85% of controls. I flagged 12 controls where ownership is shared and added suggested primary/secondary owners.
- Redaction: anything referencing raw token streams or full KV cache dumps is flagged for redaction; we should provide sanitized excerpts instead.
- Escrow preference: single ZIP with per-control manifest. That keeps evidence atomic for auditors.

I can join the Thu walkthrough — prefer 10:00 PT.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

---
From: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Elliot Systems <audit@elliotsys.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 14:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control synchronization and escrow clarity for upcoming CSA submission

Looping in a few technical details from the infra side:
- Runtime traces: we will extract a short-lived trace from the inference runtime for controls that require request/response lineage. Location: s3://redwood-prod-evidence/telemetry/2027-11/traces/. Files will be in ndjson and include redaction of any sensitive fields. I'll add exact object names to the mapping (control-sync-mapping.xlsx -> column "Evidence Path").
- KV/cache dumps: we will not include raw dumps in the escrow. We can provide a deterministic sample (sanitized) plus an attestation about sampling.
- KMS/HSM: rotation events are captured in CloudKMS logs (project: redwood-core-ops). We cannot escrow private key material — we will provide rotation events and a signed attestation from the security team.

Owner for a technical handoff during the walkthrough: Sean Gallagher (sean.gallagher@redwood.com). He'll demo the extract process and answer S3 path questions.

I'll update the mapping and push v1.1 to the Drive link by EOD.

– PrIyom
Applied ML / Inference Security, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

---
From: Elliot Systems <audit@elliotsys.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Natalie Park <natalie.park@quantumpay.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ control synchronization and escrow clarity for upcoming CSA submission

Mina / team,

Thanks for the clear plan and the artifacts. A few items from our side:
1) Walkthrough — Thu 11/04 10:00 PT works for us. Please include Sean.
2) Escrow format — single ZIP with per-control manifest is preferred. Please ensure the manifest includes: control id, file name, SHA256, and any redaction notes.
3) DocuSign — we'll send a request to the DocuSign address you listed. Natalie (QuantumPay) will need access to the escrow bundle; please confirm whether we should provision a temporary read-only S3 link or share via secure Drive.

Next steps for Redwood: provide v1.1 mapping with populated evidence paths and an owner-attestation template (one-line per owner) before EOD Fri (11/05). Once we have that, we'll trigger our intake and provide a short checklist for what the escrow ingest will accept.

Regards,
Samir Chauhan
Senior Auditor, Elliot Systems
audit@elliotsys.com
